# Hark

I set the rake aside,  
let it lie askew,   
for there's nothing left to rearrange,  
nothing else to pursue -  
with the scent of damp earth and compost leaves,  
and the speckles of light that glisten in dew drops,  
only I am here, superfluous,  
whatever I may think of my own self;  
  
not this, not that - I am neither here nor there,  
nothing to hold on to - nothing to bear.
